description: Review sites the Web Reviews site eval reads (scripts/evals/web_reviews_sites.py), page 1 only, once per method. `vendor` / `vendor_evidence`: the bot management seen in response headers from a laptop in Zurich (not from AWS). `expect`: what the plugin should get, `unknown` unless stated. `baseline`: measured on the unsigned AWS-managed browser (aws.browser.v1), `unknown` where never measured. `evidence`: where the URL, the baseline and the expectation come from.
